# Liv Functional

> Liv Functional (ليف فنكشنال) is an online functional nutrition coaching practice for insulin resistance and metabolic health, in Arabic and English. It is led by Reham Al Sharif (رهام الشريف), an IPHM-certified functional nutrition coach. Reham is not a doctor or dietitian; her programs are educational and work alongside the client's own doctor. The practice is registered in Los Angeles, California, and serves women over 40 (and men interested in metabolic health) in Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain and the wider Middle East.

Reham survived a diabetic coma, was diagnosed with LADA (latent autoimmune diabetes in adults) at 44, and lowered her own HbA1c from 12% to 6%. She wrote two books: "Reverse Insulin Resistance: The 90-Day LIV Method" (Arabic and English, printed Arabic edition) and "LADA: The First 90 Days". Her work focuses on improving metabolic markers and reversing insulin resistance through the five pillars of the LIV Method. Every page is available in Arabic under https://www.livfunctional.com/ar.

## The LIV Method: five pillars

1. Nervous System Regulation (تنظيم الجهاز العصبي)
2. The Gut-Insulin Axis (محور الأمعاء والإنسولين)
3. Functional Food as Medicine (الغذاء الوظيفي كدواء)
4. Reading Lab Results with Functional Ranges (قراءة نتائج التحاليل وفق المعدلات الوظيفية)
5. Smart Exercise with Weights: Muscle as a Metabolic Organ (التمارين الذكية بالأوزان)

## Programs

- [1:1 coaching](https://www.livfunctional.com/coaching): The Guided Reset and the LIV Method Intensive, online, with live glucose (CGM) data. Arabic: https://www.livfunctional.com/ar/coaching
- [Self-guided plans](https://www.livfunctional.com/self-guided-programs-%D8%AE%D8%B7%D8%A9-%D9%85%D9%82%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B3%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%86):
  - [30-Day Metabolic Reset](https://www.livfunctional.com/reset): four weeks for women with insulin resistance who want steadier glucose.
  - [60-Day PCOS protocol](https://www.livfunctional.com/pcos): food and lifestyle plan for PCOS-related insulin resistance.
  - [Perimenopause Management Plan](https://www.livfunctional.com/self-guided-programs-%D8%AE%D8%B7%D8%A9-%D9%85%D9%82%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B3%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%86/perimenopause-metabolic-plan)

  - Thyroid (Hashimoto's) support program
  - [CGM guide](https://www.livfunctional.com/p/cgm-guide): how to use a continuous glucose monitor.
- [LIV At Work](https://www.livfunctional.com/liv-at-work): metabolic health workshops for teams, in English or Arabic.

## Key facts

- Founder: Reham Al Sharif (رهام الشريف), IPHM-certified functional nutrition coach. Not a medical doctor or registered dietitian.
- Focus: insulin resistance, perimenopause and menopause metabolism, PCOS, LADA, hidden inflammation, stress.
- Audience: women over 40, mostly 45+; also men interested in metabolic health.
- Experience: 5+ years in practice, 150+ clients, 97% would recommend.
- Languages: Arabic and English.
- Where: online; clients mainly in Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain. Registered in Los Angeles, CA, USA.
- Contact: WhatsApp +965 9559 7962 | US +1 818 448 6680
- Social: instagram.com/livfunctional | tiktok.com/@livfunctional | linkedin.com/company/livfunctional
